Source Justification: Firefighters on the Plumas National Forest Feather River Ranger District have completed a multi-day prescribed burning operation northeast of Paradise Lake and near Magalia.

Sourced Statements: “Fire effects were excellent, smoke dispersal was good and everything went as planned,” said Feather River District Fire Management Officer James Lico.
Title of Source: Feather River District Fire Management Officer

Sourced Statements: Residents in nearby areas reported seeing a glow from the prescribed burns after dark.
Lico noted the complexity of this portion, stating, “The 10 acres planned Thursday are complex and we want to make sure we are doing it right.”
Title of Source: Feather River District Fire Management Officer

Sourced Statements: He added, “We have more than 70 firefighters assigned to this prescribed burning operation this week to ensure that is happening, with public and firefighter safety coming first as we work on this critical fuel reduction.”
Title of Source: Feather River District Fire Management Officer

Sourced Statements: “We appreciate the patience, understanding and cooperation of area residents, especially with the increased firefighting equipment traffic around neighborhoods and short term smoke impacts,” Lico said.
Title of Source: Feather River District Fire Management Officer

Sourced Statements: “There is urgency to get this work done for community protection and the past several weeks have helped us make great progress.”
